---
name: conductor-status
description: Summarizes project progress, active phases, and pending tasks.
---

Display the current status of the Conductor project:
1. Parse `conductor/tracks.md` and all track `plan.md` files.
2. Calculate total phases, total tasks, completed tasks, in-progress tasks, pending tasks, and completion percentage.
3. Report current active track, current task, next action needed, blockers, and overall progress.
